style_base: Crude hand-drawn cartoon, Ecomonos style, PURE WHITE background, thick black ink outlines, flat colors. A brown cartoon monkey protagonist named Sara, huge white round eyes with black pupils, exactly like the reference image, NO clothing of any kind, NEVER a human character. Exactly two arms and two hands per character. Any text that appears in the image must be in PERFECT SPANISH, never English, and only when the scene explicitly asks for specific words or figures. When a scene asks for a specific numeral, draw EXACTLY that numeral and never reuse a figure from another scene. Fill the whole frame, no black bars. CRITICAL: this video discusses real living researchers. NEVER draw a realistic human, a face or a portrait. When a scene asks for a person, draw ONLY a plain featureless outline pictogram, like a bathroom-sign figure, with no face. NEVER use a real brand name or logo. There is NO hooded shadow character in this video at all — never draw one. Never place any character in a scene that says 'no characters' — treat that literally, icon-only, no monkey, no people at all. Never add a speech bubble, caption or extra label unless the scene explicitly asks for one.
